Episode 225. Unwanted Reunion (1)
February 7, 1804.
The main hub of the underworld in the Demon World, named 'Groshe Castle,' was under continuous bloody battle between the alliance and the demons.

The demons were like moths to a flame, throwing themselves relentlessly day and night towards the golden ship and the ramparts. Every time the golden ship fired its cannon, thousands or tens of thousands of demons turned into a handful of ash. However, their numbers did not seem to decrease.
Rather, the attacks on the walls became more frequent, and their forces only increased.
"Most of Zito's followers are brainwashed with pain... they're like berserkers. They're watching their fellow demons charge at the walls and get swept away in vain."
"Cockroaches, they are. In the end, we have to destroy Groshe Castle, defeat Zito and smash their origin place to finally end this, kid."
In response to Murakan's words, Jin nodded. Judging from the current situation, the demon world's forces were virtually infinite. On the ground, there was never a force in the 'billions.'
It was fortunate that all those forces couldn't be summoned at once. If that had been possible, the 'Demon War' would have already ended with the victory of the Demon World.
The core of the Vamel Alliance was still a preemptive strike.
It was most crucial for the strongest superhumans in the Vamel Alliance, including Luna, to make achievements.

"Devil King, the speed at which general-level castles are summoned is still a little faster than the speed at which they are suppressed. We must suppress faster than summoning to advance to Groshe Castle. Even if we give up a bit of contingency planning, I wonder if you and I should actively participate in preemptive strikes."
"Well, if we're going to find a way right now, there's nothing else. Moomool probably will oppose it."
Casimir nodded.
"That's correct, sir. I oppose. Once the Golden Fleet and Eello's mass-production type start to be produced, the wall will be able to advance."

[I agree, Jin. If the situation was very unfavorable, it might be different, but right now there are many colleagues who can handle big battles even without you. Since the Paytel guy is devoted to research while fighting on the wall, I think it would be better to wait.]
Ameris also agreed with Casimir's opinion. All of his colleagues thought it would be best to minimize Jin's direct movements.
"That's true, but it feels like I've become a porcelain doll."

[It's because the meaning of the person named Jin Runcandel is so great in the alliance, no, in the world. The moment you have to step into the most dangerous battlefield is when only you among the superhumans of the alliance can move. Otherwise, it's best to quickly suppress and return from battles of middle and lower levels that can be sorted out easily.]
Indeed, Jin was currently sortieing primarily over areas of rift below the level of general. The rest of the time, he was on standby in the situation room, receiving reports on the situation.

There were too many variables even excluding the Demon World. Zipple's magic stone, the Red Star tribe, the recently revealed Kinzelo's dream ability, the sun god's whole god throw, and even the old heroes.
The world was now no different from a giant oil can. If a small spark catches somewhere, it could explode.
"Have there been any particular contact from Luna yet?"
Luna was dispatched this morning to handle the demonic king-level rift that reappeared in the desert of the Shucheron Kingdom.
The Oken Desert was an area that Toben, Heijin, Zed, Vanessa, and Hedo had once already subdued. Major rifts from the Demon World often reappeared in places that had been previously created.

"I was just about to tell you, Master. I received a call 10 minutes ago, and it is said that already seven warlords have been summoned in this rift. The Demon King has not been summoned yet, and the battle is said to be dragging on. The 3rd generation and Hedo are subduing other rifts in the nearby area, and if necessary, the 1st generation will contact them."

"The contact, thanks to the portable communicator. The world has indeed improved. Just a few years ago, such emergency support requests were the exclusive property of the Zipple Tower owners, isn't that right, Mifol?"

"Thanks to Master Jin securing Dr. Kwall and visiting Hister's transmission area with Valeria. Anyway, don't worry too much, Master Jin. The 1st generation will return after beautifully subduing them this time as well. There was also no specific mention of the danger of red energy."
Even after obtaining information from Viseps that the Demon World was trying to deplete Luna's red energy, Luna continued to use the red power for subjugation.

If she suddenly stopped using the red power, Tilias and Misol could be suspected. Also, Luna emphasized the fact that Chiron 'did not properly warn' about the red power. She felt like she could reach Genesis if she overcame the red power.
"I see. How about Yona?"

"She is still infiltrating the Kinzelo headquarters. However, due to the Dream Horse Filops Bachma, it seems that she can't easily enter the meeting room as she did last time. It is reported that security has been significantly strengthened since the last infiltration."
Bachma's dream ability, the contact between Kinzelo and Lokia Ganesuto, Kelliark Zipple, and the identity of Marjiella were the information Yona had to find out.
Especially, Jin really wanted to secure Kelliark Zipple before Kinzelo. It was because Shinu's fire was assumed to be the key to properly manifest Tess.
"Tell her not to overdo it."
Woowoo...!
Suddenly, the communication device in the situation room vibrated. It was a communication request from the curtain of the Milla Kingdom.
"This is Tilias of Viseps. There's important information that we urgently need to inform our allies. Is Jin Runcandel there?"
"It's me, Tilias. You've been on vacation for a while, but it seems your movement has certainly freed up. I didn't know you'd contact so soon."

{Of course, since there's a communication network now. Have you been well, Jin Runcandel? By the way, regarding Luna, is it okay that she keeps using red energy? You don't have to overdo it for us. Because she is completely out of suspicion.}
"Don't worry about that part, Misol. Luna is taking care of it."
{That's good, but I'm especially worried because Luna is a good person. Is Luna there? If she is, please respond.}
At Misol's fast talk, colleagues laughed softly. They couldn't fully trust her yet, but at least, based on their behavior so far, Viseps was generally favorable.
"Luna is currently dealing with the Demon King level rift in the Oken Desert."
{Oh, I see. It's a relief, if Luna is listening, there's some information I want to tell her.}
"If Luna is listening, I have some inconvenient information to share."
Jin's pupils narrowed. Surely, it must be about the other brothers that Ragal Fun was said to be holding onto.
"So you mentioned Sis intentionally, Misol."
{Yes, but my worries about Luna are sincere. Ah, darn it. Luna went to the Oken Desert!?}
"Is that a problem?"

{Let me explain. I just received a message from a spy in Dokmaseong. The intelligence was that the four brothers Ragal has are being used in an invasion today. And that battlefield is the Oken Desert.}
The pupils of his colleagues widened. They had heard that Myu, Anne, Lan, and Vigo could be used by Ragal, but no one thought things would unfold so quickly.
Currently, among the core executives of the Vamel Alliance, the only one who was completely unaware of the matter of the brothers in Hell was Luna.
"What did you say?"
{We informed you as quickly as we could, Jin. If there has been no contact from Luna yet, it might be best to get Luna to return quickly.}
"I understand. But, were you able to confirm who among the brothers is on the battlefield?"
{We couldn't ascertain that. However, it's highly likely that they won't use all four at once. Ragal will definitely send them one by one to wear down Luna's spirit.}
{Also, Jin! We couldn't find anything specific about the person named Marjiella you asked about last time. We'll let you know if we get any updates.}
"I'll leave a message on the Curtain when I get back."
As soon as Jin ended the communication, he immediately grabbed his sword.
-So what should we do? Well, anyway! If the day comes when we meet those deviant guys again, we have to make sure to discipline them.
-Will there be a chance to meet again?
-I'm also going to grow old and die someday, so wouldn't we meet in the afterworld or something?
-Even if the afterworld does exist, Sister and them would probably be in different places.
-Is that so? Anyway, that's what I feel. I must discipline them. Whenever that is, just as long as we meet.
A conversation shared on the day Luna returned from the Black Sea.
At that time, Luna said she would discipline the brothers, but Jin really wanted to prevent Luna from facing them.
Even though Luna had become stronger and tougher, Luna was still Luna. Seeing them cut down would certainly cause deep wounds in Luna's tender heart.

He didn't feel as guilty as Luna, but it's not like Jin didn't feel any burden. They didn't have much of a relationship, and had always been adversaries since they were alive, but they were still brothers.
But he thought it was his duty to take responsibility, not just as the head of the Vamel Alliance, but as the guardian of the Lunar Candle.
"Murakan, get ready."
This time, his colleagues didn't try to dissuade Jin from going into battle.
"...Take care, Duke."
Soon after, Jin headed straight to the Oken Desert on the Red Owl with Murakan.

The Oken Desert was already nothing short of ruins. Even though he had spatially leaped far from the battlefield, the aftermath of the battle rolled over him as soon as he arrived, and the entire desert was resonating with the smell of demon blood and the scent of burning.
It took less than ten minutes to arrive at the battlefield, but he was anxious, fearing Luna had already met the other brothers.
Fortunately, as soon as he entered the center of the battlefield, he saw Luna and Syris battling with the demon generals.
"Jin?"
Luna, who had knocked down a general in front of her, swiftly turned her body and looked at Jin. Jin adjusted his heavy expression and smiled.
"What brought you here from the Situation Room? I didn't request for backup."
"Lately, it seemed like you've been working too hard, so I thought I'd stretch my legs a bit."
He had no good excuses. Luna stared at Jin with blinking eyes, and Syris, who had noticed the situation, nodded his head.
"First Master, I was feeling an overload on the Manbing. In fact, I was thinking of requesting support today, so how about leaving the back end to the Master and stepping back for today?"
"Alright, Syris. The little guy was fretting over you using too much of your red energy, so it's frustrating to watch. I told him I'd come if that's the case. Go and take a rest."
As Luna tilted her head, Syris pretended to be anemic and touched his forehead.
"Have I ever said I wanted to rest while fighting with the First Master? Today, both I and Manbing are not in good condition, so please help me meditate when I return."
"Well, it's unlike you to feign sickness."
At last, Syris summoned Mort and opened a dimensional gate to the different world before Luna's permission even fell.
"Hurry. I feel like I'm going to faint."
"Hmm! Something feels odd."
Just then, a crack far away from the group amplified. A new general or demon king, or one of the brothers, was expected to emerge from within.
"What's odd? I'm about to die, let's go. Mort! Escort the First Master."
[Boooong.]
Mort bumped Luna with his head and lifted her onto his back.
"Hey, wait a minute! Just a minute!"
"There's no time. Well then, good luck, Master."
